overview.description: The KICK Korea Semiconductor Index ETF (KCHP) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Akros Korea Semiconductor index. The KICK Korea Semiconductor Index ETF (the Fund) seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Akros Korea Semiconductor Index (the Index). KCHP was launched on Sep 14, 2026 and is issued by KICK.
